segments.text:
The reprobate for all this knowledge, in his heart may bee an Atheist, as Dauid saith:
The foole hath said in his heart there is no God. And a man may now a daies find houses and townes full of such fooles: Nay, this glimmering light of nature, except it bee preserued with good bringing vp, with diligent instruction, and with good companie, it will be so darkened, that a man shall know verie litle, and lead a life like a very beast: as experience telleth, and Dauid knewe very well: who saith,
Man is in honour, and vnderstandeth not; he is like to beasts that perish.
